dependencies.name: Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV, Durable Objects, Queues, Workers AI, DNS, and TLS edge
dependencies.observes: Every request to forkmesh.com, app.forkmesh.com, and world.forkmesh.com terminates here: client IP address, TLS SNI, headers including User-Agent, request path, and timing. D1, KV, Durable Objects, and Queues hold the hosted service's account, catalog, collaboration, presence, and health data; sensitive fields are encrypted under DATA_KEY before storage. Workers AI receives ForkBot prompts, bug-report text, and usernames sent for moderation. Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS receives mirror hostnames and profile domains being verified. The content security policy also allows the Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon, which is a zone setting rather than repository code.
dependencies.retention: D1 rows persist until the owning feature deletes them; persisted room frames last 7 days and at most 500 per room. Workers observability on forkmesh-www, the only Worker still deployed since the app and World Workers were deleted on 2026-09-27, samples 5% of logs and traces every request, kept for the Cloudflare plan's retention; relay data on the core nodes is covered by the relay data retention page. Edge caches expire by their Cache-Control lifetimes.
dependencies.jurisdiction: Cloudflare, Inc. (United States) on a global edge network; D1 data lives in the database's primary location chosen at creation.
dependencies.canonicalData: Canonical for hosted accounts, sessions, device and SSH public keys, organization membership, the catalog, pull and issue inboxes, and routing health. Not canonical for Git objects and refs, which live on mirrors and desktops, or for signed .forkmesh records, which live in Git.
dependencies.outage: The hosted website, dashboard, API, accounts, chat, catalog, and clone routing through app.forkmesh.com stop. Direct mirror URLs keep serving Git clone, fetch, and SSH push; desktops keep local Git, signed records, and direct mirror access; the Go mirror node keeps publishing signed health locally.
dependencies.recovery: Service resumes when Cloudflare recovers; D1 point-in-time restore and the node backup runbook cover data loss. The router reverts to the last accepted signed refs pins.
dependencies.alternative: Clone from any independent mirror node's direct HTTPS or SSH URL. A self-host deploys its own app Worker on its own Cloudflare account; no non-Cloudflare runtime for the app Worker exists yet.
dependencies.gap: The app Worker has no non-Cloudflare runtime, so a self-host cannot leave Cloudflare for accounts, catalog, and realtime; only Git serving is provider-independent.
dependencies.privacyDisclosure: Cloudflare hosts the public website at forkmesh.com, passes requests made there on to ForkMesh’s servers, and provides DNS for ForkMesh domains. The app, APIs, account data, and relay infrastructure run on ForkMesh’s own servers.

dependencies.name: ACME certificate authorities for direct-HTTPS mirrors
dependencies.observes: The mirror's public hostname and the host's IP address during certificate issuance and renewal. Issued certificates are published in public Certificate Transparency logs.
dependencies.retention: Certificate Transparency entries are permanent and public.
dependencies.jurisdiction: Caddy's default issuers, Let's Encrypt (ISRG, United States) and ZeroSSL, unless the operator configures another ACME issuer.
dependencies.canonicalData: None. The certificate is a cache the proxy renews.
dependencies.outage: Existing certificates keep serving until they expire, so clones continue. New direct-HTTPS mirrors cannot obtain a certificate, and a mirror whose renewal keeps failing stops serving HTTPS at expiry; its SSH gateway and other mirrors are unaffected.
dependencies.recovery: Caddy retries renewal automatically; the operator can switch ACME issuer or use the Cloudflare Tunnel mode.
dependencies.alternative: Self-host operators may point Caddy at any ACME issuer or their own certificate, or run the mirror node in Cloudflare Tunnel mode.
dependencies.gap: No automated drill simulates ACME issuance failure or certificate expiry on a direct-HTTPS mirror.

dependencies.name: GitHub source and release downloads
dependencies.observes: The downloading host's IP address and the release or repository requested: desktop self-update clones of forkmesh/forkmesh when no source checkout exists, the age binary for the macOS installer, the pinned cloudflared release, and build toolchains.
dependencies.retention: Set by GitHub's access-log terms; ForkMesh does not configure it.
dependencies.canonicalData: None. ForkMesh's canonical source is served by ForkMesh mirrors; GitHub holds a synchronized copy.
dependencies.outage: Desktop self-update without a local checkout, first-time macOS installs that need age, cloudflared installation, and toolchain bootstraps fail with a download error. Running desktops, mirrors, and the hosted service are unaffected.
dependencies.recovery: Retry after GitHub recovers, or install the same pinned artifact from a ForkMesh release mirror.
dependencies.alternative: Update from a local source checkout or a ForkMesh mirror clone; self-host operators can preinstall age and cloudflared from their distribution.
dependencies.gap: No drill runs the desktop updater or install.sh with github.com unreachable.

dependencies.name: GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg APIs for imports, GitHub sync and repository mirrors
dependencies.observes: The owner and repository being imported, the Worker's egress IP, and a user-supplied access token when the user provides one. The GitHub sync workflow reads and writes issues, discussions, and pull requests of the connected repository. A repository mirror set up in repository settings sends the owner's stored access token with every API call and Git push, and the forge sees the mirrored branches, tags, issues, comments, discussions and releases.
dependencies.retention: Set by each forge's API log terms. ForkMesh never stores user-supplied import tokens. A mirror's access token is stored encrypted until the owner disconnects the mirror.
dependencies.jurisdiction: GitHub, Inc. (United States); GitLab Inc. (United States); Codeberg e.V. (Germany).
dependencies.canonicalData: The forge is canonical for its own repository until import; after import the ForkMesh repository and its signed records are canonical, and the stored external id only links the two.
dependencies.outage: New imports, scheduled GitHub sync and repository mirrors fail with a named provider error; mirror items stay queued and retry. Imported repositories, clones, and collaboration keep working.
dependencies.recovery: Retry the import; the sync workflow resumes on its next schedule and is idempotent.
dependencies.alternative: Push the repository directly to a ForkMesh mirror with stock Git; no forge API is needed.

dependencies.name: GitHub Actions hosted runners
dependencies.observes: The full public repository source, test output, and uploaded evidence artifacts for every run on ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, and windows-latest. Workflows check out with persist-credentials: false.
dependencies.retention: Evidence artifacts are uploaded with retention-days: 30; run logs follow GitHub's retention.
dependencies.canonicalData: None. Results are evidence copies; ForkMesh Actions on mirrors run the deploy-gating suites.
dependencies.outage: GitHub-hosted conformance evidence stops. Deploys are gated by .forkmesh workflows on the ForkMesh Actions runner, which runs with network egress disabled.
dependencies.recovery: Re-run the workflows after GitHub recovers.
dependencies.alternative: Run tools/quality_gate.py run --profile core locally or on the self-hosted ForkMesh Actions runner.

dependencies.name: Package registries and distribution mirrors
dependencies.observes: The build host's IP address and the exact package names and versions requested.
dependencies.retention: Set by each registry's download-log terms.
dependencies.jurisdiction: npm (GitHub, United States); PyPI (Python Software Foundation, United States); Go module proxy (Google, United States); Debian and Ubuntu mirrors (various).
dependencies.canonicalData: None. Lock files and the dependency audit pin exact versions; the Worker and the Go mirror node use only their language standard libraries.
dependencies.outage: Fresh builds that need to download packages fail. Deployed services never contact registries, and the ForkMesh Actions critical suites use preinstalled packages.
dependencies.recovery: Retry the build, or build from a warm package cache.
dependencies.alternative: Self-host builds may use a local package mirror or cache; the app Worker and mirror node need no third-party packages at runtime.

dependencies.name: Code-signing timestamp authorities
dependencies.observes: A hash of the Windows installer being signed and the release host's IP address.
dependencies.retention: Set by each timestamp authority.
dependencies.canonicalData: None.
dependencies.outage: Windows release signing falls through to the next timestamp server, and fails only if all three are down. Existing releases are unaffected.
dependencies.recovery: Re-run the Windows packaging step.
dependencies.alternative: Release without a timestamp and re-sign later, or use another RFC 3161 authority.
dependencies.gap: No drill exercises the timestamp fallback list.

dependencies.name: Mailtrap transactional email
dependencies.observes: Recipient email address, subject and body of verification, password, invitation, and notice email, a ForkMesh send id, and delivery, bounce, and spam events. Open and click events only if the operator's plan enables tracking.
dependencies.retention: Mailtrap keeps email logs per the operator's plan. ForkMesh keeps send status rows keyed by account blind index and webhook event ids for replay rejection.
dependencies.jurisdiction: Mailtrap (Railsware); data region per the operator's Mailtrap account.
dependencies.canonicalData: None. Account email addresses are canonical in D1, encrypted; Mailtrap message ids only settle delivery status.
dependencies.outage: Verification, password, and notice email is not delivered and the status page's email system turns red. Signup falls back to the administrator verification queue; a failed notice never undoes the change it announces. Git, accounts, and collaboration continue.
dependencies.recovery: Resend from the account page or administrator console after Mailtrap recovers; delivery status settles from the next webhook or log lookup.
dependencies.alternative: A self-host may leave MAILTRAP_API_TOKEN unset and verify accounts from the administrator queue. No other email provider adapter exists yet.

dependencies.name: Apple Push Notification service
dependencies.observes: The device token, the app topic com.forkmesh.forkmesh, the time of each push, and the text of each alert: a ping's headline, repository, actor and body; the sender or channel name of a chat or direct message (never its encrypted text).
dependencies.retention: Set by Apple. ForkMesh stores the token encrypted, keyed by a blind index, and prunes it on a permanent failure.
dependencies.canonicalData: None. The event itself stays in ForkMesh; the push only wakes the app.
dependencies.outage: Suspended iOS apps are not woken. The account event socket still delivers updates whenever the app is open, and no other client uses APNs.
dependencies.recovery: Delivery resumes automatically; unread counts are read on the next app open.
dependencies.alternative: Open the app, or use the desktop or web client; a self-host leaves the APNs secrets unset and push becomes a silent no-op.

dependencies.name: Discord API, OAuth, CDN, and gateway
dependencies.observes: For linked accounts and organizations: the Discord user id, guilds, and channel ids involved in OAuth; messages the bot reads from the configured #bugs channel and the replies it posts; bridged organization channel messages. Browsers load Discord avatar images directly from cdn.discordapp.com, which exposes the viewer's IP address to Discord.
dependencies.retention: Set by Discord. ForkMesh stores the Discord user id as a blind index with the raw id encrypted, and keeps the public #bugs channel cursor as a plaintext message id.
dependencies.canonicalData: Discord is canonical for Discord messages only. Bug reports it files become signed ForkMesh issues, which are canonical in Git.
dependencies.outage: Discord sign-in linking, organization channel bridging, and the #bugs watcher stop with an expected-degraded response. ForkMesh accounts, chat, and issues are unaffected.
dependencies.recovery: The watcher resumes from its stored message cursor; OAuth links can be retried.
dependencies.alternative: A self-host leaves the Discord secrets unset; ForkMesh chat and issue filing need no Discord.

dependencies.name: Patreon memberships
dependencies.observes: When a member links Patreon: their Patreon identity, email, pledge amount, patron status, and next charge date, read through OAuth and the creator token. Pledge webhooks. Checkout pages are opened in the user's browser at their direction.
dependencies.retention: Set by Patreon. ForkMesh discards member OAuth tokens immediately and stores the Patreon user id as a blind index with membership data encrypted.
dependencies.canonicalData: Patreon is canonical for payment and pledge state; ForkMesh derives badge and Pro plan state from it.
dependencies.outage: New links, pledge reconciliation, and supporter badge updates pause; unconfigured deployments answer an expected-degraded 503. Repository access, identity, and collaboration never depend on it.
dependencies.recovery: The next webhook or reconciliation run restores membership state.
dependencies.alternative: Self-host operators leave Patreon unset; paid plans are optional adapters.
dependencies.gap: No drill simulates a Patreon API outage during member reconciliation.

dependencies.name: Solana JSON-RPC providers
dependencies.observes: Public addresses whose balances are read, transaction signatures being verified, signed transactions being broadcast, and the caller's IP address.
dependencies.retention: Set by each RPC provider. Everything sent is already public chain data.
dependencies.jurisdiction: PublicNode, Ankr, dRPC, and Solana Labs endpoints; the operator's SOLANA_RPC_URL goes first when set.
dependencies.canonicalData: The Solana ledger is canonical for balances and transactions; ForkMesh caches display balances.
dependencies.outage: Tips, bounties, reward pool balances, and store purchase confirmation degrade across the fallback list and then show the last reading or a stale marker. Repository access, identity, contribution, and governance never read them.
dependencies.recovery: The next successful RPC read refreshes balances; pending verifications retry.
dependencies.alternative: Point SOLANA_RPC_URL at your own Solana node, or self-host with incentives unconfigured.
dependencies.privacyDisclosure: A configured Solana JSON-RPC endpoint is queried for public pool balances

dependencies.name: CoinGecko price API
dependencies.observes: The Worker's or desktop's IP address and a request for the SOL price. No user data.
dependencies.retention: Set by CoinGecko.
dependencies.canonicalData: None. The price is cached for five minutes.
dependencies.outage: Ledger fiat values show as unavailable (price 0). Balances in SOL and every other feature continue.
dependencies.recovery: The next cache refresh after recovery restores the price.
dependencies.alternative: Show SOL amounts only; a self-host needs nothing.
dependencies.gap: No drill forces a CoinGecko failure through the ledger price path.

dependencies.name: Sentry error reporting
dependencies.observes: A generalized, redacted route, method, status, service host, Cloudflare Ray id, coarse edge colo, transport versions, and code stack locations. No raw IP, country, User-Agent, cookies, authorization, or query strings; private-repository routes are replaced by a fixed redaction.
dependencies.retention: Set by the operator's Sentry organization; the D1 error log is kept separately.
dependencies.jurisdiction: The host inside SENTRY_DSN: sentry.io (Functional Software, Inc., United States) or a self-hosted Sentry.
dependencies.canonicalData: None. D1 error rows remain the operator's own record.
dependencies.outage: Error events and cron check-ins are dropped; reporting failures never fail the request being served, and the D1 error log still records the event.
dependencies.recovery: Nothing to replay; new errors report once Sentry recovers.
dependencies.alternative: Leave SENTRY_DSN unset and read the D1 error log, or self-host Sentry.
dependencies.privacyDisclosure: An instance operator may configure Sentry for server-error reporting

dependencies.name: jsDelivr CDN (lucide icons on dashboard pages)
dependencies.observes: Every dashboard page load: the visitor's IP address, User-Agent, and the referring dashboard origin, when the browser fetches lucide@0.468.0.
dependencies.retention: Set by jsDelivr and its CDN providers.
dependencies.jurisdiction: jsDelivr (Prospect One) served through multiple global CDNs.
dependencies.canonicalData: None.
dependencies.outage: Dashboard icons do not render; pages call window.lucide?.createIcons() and otherwise work.
dependencies.recovery: Icons return on the next load after the CDN recovers.
dependencies.alternative: Serving lucide from the app's own assets removes this dependency; self-host operators can block the CDN without losing function.
dependencies.gap: The script has no Subresource Integrity hash, no test loads the dashboard with the CDN blocked, and the privacy notice says no third-party CDN is loaded.

dependencies.name: YouTube video embeds
dependencies.observes: The visitor's IP address and User-Agent when a page loads a youtube-nocookie iframe; playback activity once the visitor plays the video.
dependencies.retention: Set by Google.
dependencies.canonicalData: None.
dependencies.outage: The demo video does not appear; the page otherwise works.
dependencies.recovery: None required.
dependencies.alternative: Host the video file on ForkMesh assets, or use a local poster image and load the embed only on click.
dependencies.gap: The blog iframe loads without a click and is not named in the privacy notice.

dependencies.name: World social feeds (X, Reddit, Mastodon)
dependencies.observes: The World Worker's egress IP when it reads the public ForkMesh X and Reddit feeds. Visitors' browsers look up the public ForkMesh Mastodon account directly on mastodon.social, which exposes the visitor's IP address.
dependencies.retention: Set by each network. Feed documents are edge cached.
dependencies.jurisdiction: X Corp. (United States); Reddit, Inc. (United States); Mastodon gGmbH for mastodon.social (Germany).
dependencies.canonicalData: None.
dependencies.outage: World banners show their static sign and a named unavailable reason. The World and every other feature continue.
dependencies.recovery: The next timed refresh restores the banner.
dependencies.alternative: A self-host omits the World or leaves the feeds unconfigured.

dependencies.name: CRM contact pictures and their accounts' public posts
dependencies.observes: The reading device's IP address and which account was asked about. A CRM page reads a picture for each contact whose record names a GitHub, Bluesky or Mastodon account, a contact's detail card reads that account's newest public posts, and the Reach out card reads the newest Mastodon post of up to 40 never-contacted contacts to order them. The desktop CRM also asks Gravatar for a picture by the SHA-256 hash of each contact's email address when the contact has no ForkMesh or account picture. The Mastodon instance is whichever one the contact's handle names, so it is not a fixed host.
dependencies.retention: Set by each service. The pictures and posts live in the page's memory for the session and are never written to disk.
dependencies.jurisdiction: GitHub, Inc. (United States); Bluesky Social, PBC (United States); Automattic Inc. for Gravatar (United States); the operator of whichever Mastodon instance a contact's handle names.
dependencies.canonicalData: None. The record's own handle is canonical; nothing read here is stored.
dependencies.outage: Rows keep the contact's initials, and a detail card names the service it could not read. Every field, the linked mail and the pipeline still work.
dependencies.recovery: The CRM page's Refresh button, or the detail card's Read again button.
dependencies.alternative: Leave the profile fields empty: a record that names no account is never read, and no card reads anything until it is opened.

dependencies.name: CelesTrak satellite orbital elements
dependencies.observes: The Worker's egress IP on a cron refresh. Visitors never contact CelesTrak.
dependencies.retention: Set by CelesTrak.
dependencies.canonicalData: None. The last good snapshot is kept in D1.
dependencies.outage: World satellites keep the last good orbital snapshot and record a refresh status.
dependencies.recovery: The next cron refresh replaces the snapshot.
dependencies.alternative: A self-host omits the World sky layer.

dependencies.name: ActivityPub peer servers
dependencies.observes: Public activities ForkMesh publishes, the actor's public key, and HTTP signatures, delivered to the inboxes of remote followers; remote servers fetching actor profiles see the requesting server's IP address.
dependencies.retention: Set by each remote server; deletes are federated but cannot be enforced.
dependencies.canonicalData: ForkMesh is canonical for its own actors and posts; remote actor records are cached copies of what peers publish.
dependencies.outage: Delivery to that peer is queued for retry; local posting and every other feature continue.
dependencies.recovery: Queued deliveries retry from the D1 outbox.
dependencies.alternative: Disable federation; local posts remain.

dependencies.name: Hosted AI model providers (user-supplied keys)
dependencies.observes: Prompts the user chooses to send, including issue threads, pull request diffs, and repository context, with the user's own API key; usage and cost queries for that key. Agent CLI install scripts are downloaded from claude.ai and chatgpt.com when the user installs them on a node.
dependencies.retention: Set by the provider for the user's own account.
dependencies.canonicalData: None. Generated text becomes canonical only when a user commits or signs it.
dependencies.outage: That agent run or assistant action fails with the provider's error. Manual work and local models are unaffected.
dependencies.recovery: Retry the run.
dependencies.alternative: Use a local Ollama model or Workers AI; keys stay on the user's device.
dependencies.gap: No drill simulates a hosted model API outage in the desktop or mobile agent.

dependencies.name: Vultr server provisioning
dependencies.observes: The user's own Vultr API key and the instance they create, including cloud-init data with the Cloudflare token and payout address they supplied.
dependencies.retention: Set by Vultr for the user's account. ForkMesh does not store the key.
dependencies.canonicalData: Vultr is canonical for the virtual machine only.
dependencies.outage: One-click mirror host creation fails at that step; existing hosts keep running.
dependencies.recovery: Retry provisioning.
dependencies.alternative: Install the mirror node on any Linux host with install.sh.
dependencies.gap: No drill simulates a Vultr API outage during provisioning.

dependencies.name: Zoho Mail for the CRM marketplace package
dependencies.observes: For users who install the CRM package and connect Zoho Mail: OAuth tokens and the mail they choose to sync.
dependencies.retention: Set by Zoho.
dependencies.jurisdiction: Zoho Corporation, in the data center region of the user's Zoho account.
dependencies.canonicalData: Zoho is canonical for the mailbox; CRM records are canonical in the package's own storage.
dependencies.outage: Mail sync fails inside the CRM package; the rest of ForkMesh is unaffected.
dependencies.recovery: Retry sync.
dependencies.alternative: Uninstall the package or use the CRM without a mail connection.
dependencies.gap: No drill covers Zoho being unreachable.

dependencies.name: RDAP whois for CRM email open pings
dependencies.observes: The App's egress IP and the public IP address that first opened or clicked a tracked CRM email (often the mail provider's image proxy).
dependencies.retention: Set by each regional internet registry and by rdap.org.
dependencies.jurisdiction: rdap.org (United Kingdom); ARIN (United States), RIPE NCC (Netherlands), APNIC (Australia), LACNIC (Uruguay), AFRINIC (Mauritius).
dependencies.canonicalData: The registries are canonical for IP allocation records; nothing is stored by ForkMesh.
dependencies.outage: The open or click ping says the whois had no answer; tracking and the ping still work.
dependencies.recovery: None needed; the next email's first open looks up again.
dependencies.alternative: Remove the RDAP origins from the CRM manifest and the ping shows only the user agent.
dependencies.gap: No drill covers RDAP being unreachable beyond the package test of a failed lookup.

dependencies.name: ipify public IP lookup in the installer
dependencies.observes: The installing host's public IP address.
dependencies.retention: Set by ipify.
dependencies.canonicalData: None.
dependencies.outage: Direct-mirror setup warns and stops at the public-address step.
dependencies.recovery: Re-run the step.
dependencies.alternative: Set FORKMESH_PUBLIC_ADDRESS so the installer never contacts ipify.
dependencies.gap: No drill runs install.sh with ipify unreachable.

dependencies.name: OSV vulnerability database
dependencies.observes: Package names and versions being checked, and the operator's IP address.
dependencies.retention: Set by Google's OSV service.
dependencies.canonicalData: None.
dependencies.outage: The manual security scan cannot query advisories. No workflow or runtime path depends on it.
dependencies.recovery: Re-run the scan.
dependencies.alternative: Use an offline OSV database export.

dependencies.name: Repository webhook endpoints owners register
dependencies.observes: Each registered endpoint receives one signed JSON event per subscribed repository change: the repository's owner and name, its public URLs, the moved refs (branch, before/after commit, refs digest), merged pull numbers and the merging account, released tags and their notes, plus the relay's outbound IP address. Only public repositories emit events. api.codemagic.io is the one endpoint ForkMesh itself registers, for its own repository's mobile builds.
dependencies.retention: Set by each endpoint operator. ForkMesh keeps the encrypted destination and signing secret until the owner deletes the webhook, queued deliveries until they settle, and the newest 20 delivery outcomes per endpoint.
dependencies.jurisdiction: Wherever the endpoint the repository owner chose operates; Codemagic is Nevercode OU (Estonia).
dependencies.canonicalData: None. Every event repeats state that is canonical in Git and the catalog.
dependencies.outage: Deliveries retry with capped backoff and are dropped after 6 attempts; the Settings tab shows the failure. Pushes, merges, and releases are unaffected because delivery is queued out of band.
dependencies.recovery: Send a test delivery from the repository's Settings tab once the endpoint is back, or push again.
dependencies.alternative: Delete the webhook and poll the public catalog with tools/forkmesh_integration.py watch instead; nothing in ForkMesh depends on an endpoint answering.
dependencies.gap: A dead endpoint is only visible on the repository's own Settings tab; there is no aggregate alert.
dependencies.privacyDisclosure: Webhook endpoints a repository owner registers receive that repository's public activity

dependencies.name: Git remotes, plugin endpoints, and pages users choose
dependencies.observes: Requests to Git upstreams a mirror is configured to follow, marketplace manifests and plugin-declared endpoints a user installs, and public pages a microjob reads. Each receives the requesting server's IP address and only the request needed.
dependencies.retention: Set by each remote operator.
dependencies.canonicalData: The upstream is canonical for its own repository until the mirror's accepted signed refs pin moves.
dependencies.outage: Only the affected mirror sync, plugin call, or page read fails; mirrors keep serving the last accepted refs.
dependencies.recovery: The next sync retries.
dependencies.alternative: Push directly to the mirror instead of following an upstream.
dependencies.gap: Failure is local to each chosen remote; no aggregate drill exists.
dependencies.privacyDisclosure: Git remotes you choose may receive network requests

privacyFindings.contradicts: no third-party CDN is loaded at runtime
privacyFindings.finding: Fourteen app dashboard pages load lucide from cdn.jsdelivr.net without Subresource Integrity.
The homepage demo poster and the blog iframe contact Google without being listed as a third party.
World visitors' browsers query mastodon.social directly, and the World Worker reads X and Reddit, without being listed.

A CRM page reads contact pictures, and a contact's detail card reads that account's public posts, straight from GitHub, Bluesky, Gravatar and the Mastodon instance the record names, without those services being listed.
Transactional email content and recipient addresses go to Mailtrap, which the notice does not name.
iOS device tokens go to Apple Push Notification service, which the web notice does not name (the store disclosures do).
Discord account linking, the #bugs watcher, and avatar images involve Discord, which the notice does not name.
Patreon membership linking reads identity, email, and pledge state, which the notice does not name.

Hackathon share intent URL opened by the user.

Mobile link to create an API key.
